Villedor’s environment offers so much variety that exploring never feels dull. The parkour is one of the best parts of Dying Light 2. I also enjoyed the Tower Raid experience. it added variety to the gameplay. Personally, I find the story stronger than the first game, especially because of the characters and world design. # Dying Light 2: Stay Human

### "Humanity is dying. At least the parkour is alive."

**Recommended. Absolutely worth the fall.**

The world ended, civilization collapsed, and humanity somehow decided that living on rooftops was a reasonable career choice.

Welcome to Villedor.

Dying Light 2 takes everything that made the first game fun and throws you into a massive open world where every rooftop is a playground, every building is a shortcut, and every wrong turn can become a one-way trip to the ground floor.

The parkour feels incredible. Gliding across rooftops, swinging between buildings, and barely surviving a fall you definitely should not have survived never gets old. Combat is brutal, weapons break, infected swarm the streets, and sometimes the best strategy is to run like you've got 47 unpaid bills chasing you.

And then there's nighttime.

The streets become a death sentence, infected become nightmares with legs, and suddenly that tiny UV light looks more valuable than your entire inventory. You can spend the whole day feeling like an unstoppable badass, only to spend the night screaming internally while running for your life.

The story has its ups and downs, and not every choice hits as hard as it should. But the atmosphere, exploration, movement, and sheer chaos of surviving in Villedor make it ridiculously easy to lose hours in this world.

Is it perfect? No.

Does it always reach the same level of horror as the first game? Not quite.

But when you're flying off a skyscraper, deploying your paraglider at the last possible second, landing on a rooftop, and immediately dropkicking an infected into the next dimension, you remember exactly why you bought this game.

**Dying Light 2 isn't just about staying human. It's about losing 30 minutes of your life because you saw a cool rooftop and forgot you had actual missions to complete.**

**9/10 — The world may be falling apart, but I'm still hitting every rooftop like I own the place.**

*Keep moving. Trust nobody. And for the love of God, get inside before sunset.*

The Review

Dying Light 2 is one of those games that took me a while to fully appreciate. The story and characters can be hit or miss, and some of the dialogue feels a little cheesy, but once you get into the parkour and combat, the game becomes seriously fun.

The parkour is easily the best part. Running across rooftops, jumping between buildings, and escaping a horde of infected never really gets old. The nighttime sections are also genuinely tense, especially when you’re underleveled and suddenly realize you’ve got way more zombies chasing you than you can handle.

The combat feels good once you unlock more skills and get better gear, and there’s a decent amount of freedom in how you approach situations. The world itself is also fun to explore, with plenty of random encounters, side activities, and things to discover.

The Reloaded Edition is a great package if you’re starting fresh, especially with the extra content and improvements that have been added since launch. That said, the game still has some bugs and occasional jank, and the story definitely isn't going to be the main reason you keep playing.

Overall, it's a really fun open-world zombie game with fantastic movement, satisfying combat, and a surprisingly addictive gameplay loop.

8/10 — If you like zombies, parkour, and exploring open worlds, definitely worth picking up.

反派拉万的塑造非常成功，屡次想害死主角并且差点得手，站中间串四面八方也是主线剧情的核心冲突点；意气用事、冲动鲁莽、粗俗暴躁、毫无大局等性格特点也是经典反派形象了；外貌难评、脏话乱喷，还磕过药，一个底层混混形象跃然纸上；最后在主角的劝导下自我牺牲，这一反转大快人心，拉万终于悔过，尽显角色弧光。
剧情演绎到最终章才终于明白一名老父亲对女儿的深情，为了拯救女儿忍辱负重，不惜对自己生化改造，对抗各路妖魔神人，直到最后还想要利用导弹夷平城市，为人类铲除这么一个无药可救的鬼地方，正义之心令人动容。
相比第一代，这一作人类对抗丧尸末日明显轻松愉快得多，不仅幸存者众多，而且拉帮结派分成了三个阵营，还各自建立起了颇具规模的基地和各有特色秩序，而不用团结起来去对抗危险的夜魔和毒尸；不像第一部那样，幸存者都寥寥无几，安全点只能被迫建造在险峻的高处。看来到了第二部的时间点，人类战胜末日已经指日可待啦。

· 联机机制加大分，和伙伴们一起跑酷杀丧尸搜刮物资，甚至到晚上一起杀夜魔，这种感觉是单人无法体会的。当然联机游玩bug也是相当多的，包括但不限于过场动画后黑屏，敌人卡住杀不死，地板吞武器，电梯按了没反应。而且貌似服务器问题比较多，总是掉线。
· 罐头味十足，满地图问号感叹号你就清吧。支线做的很拉胯，几乎都是跑腿，奖励也相当敷衍，完全没有推支线的动力。
· 场景重复度太高。印象中GRE实验室，地铁站，废弃商店纯复制粘贴，玩多了容易审美疲劳。
· 剧情平庸，主线就是找妹妹，主角纯工具人，被各方势力到处使唤来使唤去。人物对话也是又臭又长，无聊至极。人物角色塑造也没什么亮点，Hakon和Waltz应该是我觉得塑造相对较好的两个角色，对拉万无感。结局更是反人类，具体就不剧透了。
· 后期战斗数值膨胀，难度崩坏，武器伤害严重溢出，游玩乐趣大大降低。个人建议开荒期普通难度，后期调整为困难或噩梦难度。
最后总结一下，有朋友一起的话强烈推荐，联机游玩的快乐足以弥补很大一部分缺点；单人游玩建议慎重考虑。
